controls.title: Version Control
controls.summary: All source, IaC and pipeline definitions live in version control with an auditable history and protected default branch.
requirements: MUST store all source and infrastructure-as-code in a version control system.
MUST protect the default branch (no direct pushes; changes land via reviewed merge requests).
SHOULD record the exact commit SHA on every build trail.

framework_refs.note: Change is authorised and tracked through version control history.
Configuration change control over source and IaC.

controls.title: Artifact Provenance
controls.summary: Every deployable artifact carries provenance linking it to the commit, pipeline and build that produced it.
requirements: MUST record a provenance attestation (artifact SHA256 + source commit + build reference) for each artifact.
SHOULD capture whether the build tree was clean or dirty.

framework_refs.note: SLSA provenance ties the artifact to its build.
Cryptographic hashes detect unauthorised modification of software.
Attestations confirm the artifact originated from the controlled pipeline.

controls.title: Software Bill of Materials
controls.summary: A machine-readable SBOM is produced and recorded for each artifact so its components are known.
requirements: MUST attach an SBOM (CycloneDX or SPDX) attestation to the artifact.
SHOULD diff SBOMs between builds to surface added or bumped dependencies.

framework_refs.note: Tracks configuration items and component inventory of the software.

controls.title: Artifact Signing & Verification
controls.summary: Artifacts are cryptographically signed and their signatures verified before deployment.
requirements: MUST sign release images/artifacts (e.g. cosign/Sigstore).
MUST verify the signature and expected signer/issuer before deploy.

framework_refs.note: Signature verification blocks unsigned or tampered artifacts.
Integrity verification of software before use.

controls.title: Peer Review (Four-Eyes)
controls.summary: Every change is reviewed by a person other than its author before it can be released.
requirements: MUST require at least one approving reviewer distinct from the change author.
MUST prevent the author from approving their own change.

framework_refs.note: Independent review authorises the change.
Separation of duties: reviewer must differ from author.

controls.title: Deployment Approval Gate
controls.summary: A deploy proceeds only on an evidence-backed approval verdict from the change-gate.
requirements: MUST evaluate the change-gate before production deploy and block on a non-approve verdict.
SHOULD surface the risk score and failing/missing controls to the approver.

framework_refs.note: Deployment is gated on documented approval.
Changes are approved before implementation.

controls.title: Segregation of Duties
controls.summary: The committer, approver and deployer of a change are three distinct identities.
requirements: MUST prove committer != approver != deployer for gated changes.
MUST record each role's identity on the trail.

framework_refs.note: Duties are separated across distinct identities.
No single person can author, approve and deploy a change.

controls.title: Vulnerability Scanning
controls.summary: Artifacts and dependencies are scanned for known vulnerabilities, with results recorded as evidence.
requirements: MUST run SCA / container vulnerability scanning in the pipeline.
SHOULD gate on severity thresholds via a policy rule.

framework_refs.note: Vulnerabilities are identified and evaluated.
Vulnerabilities are detected before release.

controls.title: Runtime Snapshot & Drift Detection
controls.summary: Running workloads are snapshotted and diffed so drift and unregistered (shadow) changes are detected.
requirements: MUST periodically snapshot each environment's running workloads.
SHOULD flag running artifacts with no recorded provenance as shadow changes.

framework_refs.note: Detects deviation from the approved configuration.
Unauthorised runtime changes are detected.

controls.title: Change Records
controls.summary: Production changes are recorded against a change-management record with the gate verdict attached.
requirements: MUST associate a change record (e.g. ServiceNow CR) with production deploys.
SHOULD write the change-gate verdict and risk back onto the record.

framework_refs.note: Changes are documented and traceable.
Change records evidence authorisation.

controls.title: Tamper-Evident Evidence Ledger
controls.summary: Evidence is chained so that any modification of recorded attestations is detectable.
requirements: MUST hash-chain attestations on each trail (content hash + previous hash).
SHOULD support verifying a trail's chain integrity on demand.

framework_refs.note: Protects audit evidence from unauthorised modification.
Integrity of the evidence record is assured.

controls.title: Continuous Control Testing
controls.summary: Control coverage is evaluated continuously against recorded evidence, not just at audit time.
requirements: MUST map controls to required evidence types and evaluate coverage on an ongoing basis.
SHOULD expose a control timeline showing pass/fail over time.

framework_refs.note: Controls are monitored on an ongoing basis.
Continuous monitoring of control effectiveness.
